title: Usage-based public developer API (reordered pitch)
idea: Our customers are B2B SaaS sales tools, and the way they use us is one overnight job that batch-enriches an entire CRM list. Pricing matches that shape: pure usage-based, $0.02 per successful lookup, free tier 500 calls/month. Auth is API keys only — no OAuth yet. We promise a 'weekly' refresh SLA. The data itself is scraped and licensed from mixed sources. What comes back for a company domain is firmographic: employee count bands, funding stage, tech stack hints. It's a public REST API.
focus_notes: Abuse / key leakage and unbounded batch jobs
Versioning / breaking changes for CRM integrators
Unit economics when free tier + scrapers dominate cost
